ui.hero.title: One platform to manage every animal you care for
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and team collaboration covering all your venues. With real screens, find any task in Antz.
ui.modules.lede: Click any card to open the corresponding guide and see all features and their screens.
ui.cta.text: This guide contains the features and real screens of every module. You can continue from where you last stopped, or contact us, and we will provide you with help.
ui.day.title: Your first day using Antz
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that match your organization, and turn on permissions module by module, so that everyone can see the content needed for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Can it be used on mobile phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app is for on-site work, such as records, treatment, transfers and egg records. The web app is for desk work, such as the hospital system, nursery setup, reports and pharmacy inventory. Updates sync in real time to phones, tablets and desktop computers.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who can view what content?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access permissions are based on roles. You can create the roles your organization uses (for example "zoologist") and turn on permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We manage multiple venues; can this be supported?
ui.faq.a4: Antz gathers the data of all venues and departments in one place. Housing is organized by venue, area and exhibit area, and transfers between venues require approval and a security exit check.
ui.faq.a5: Please first read the "Quick Start" guide, then open the modules used by your role. If anything is unclear, please send an email to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The autopsy module records post-mortem examinations, including detailed observations, examination findings for each organ and medical conclusions. It supports accurate cause-of-death analysis, unifies the report format, ensures timely handling of carcasses, and complies with legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filter
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by venue, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the transfer stages: awaiting receipt, pending processing, draft and completed. [?]
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause of death, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The deworming module supports systematic recording and monitoring of parasite-control treatments, ensuring timely administration, standardized records, and clear tracking of every deworming of every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: View by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings are categorized as upcoming, pending, skipped and completed, for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule deworming courses, or directly record administered medicine, including the confirmed date and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Record dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The housing module organizes animal habitats by venue, area and exhibit area, so that every animal has a clear location and every change is recorded. Access at every level is based on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Venue management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit venues, achieving safe, orderly access with role-based permissions.
m.housing.f2.title: Area management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit areas within the park, ensuring safe management through permission-based control.
m.housing.f3.title: Exhibit area management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit exhibit areas and monitor each exhibit area, managing animals and data efficiently.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The fetal death module records and manages fetal death events within exhibit areas, capturing cause of death, time and related animal details. It supports improvement of veterinary care, breeding health monitoring, trend analysis and population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record a new event, including cause of death, time, parents and animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filter
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by venue, date, stillbirth or miscarriage, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, days of death, cause of death, number, exhibit area, venue, sex. [?]
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the complete life cycle of an egg, from laying to hatching or transfer to the nursery, ensuring accurate records, real-time updates and complete traceability, and strengthening coordination and accountability among the nest area, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Real-time statistics: number of eggs in nest, already transferred to nursery, marked as to be discarded.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest/nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs, including parents, condition, date, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the complete timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Medication administration
m.administer-medicine.intro: The medication administration module is a supplement to medical records, turning prescriptions into executable treatment workflows, supporting real-time delivery of treatment to single or batches of animals on site or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the selected date, without filling in a complete medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filter
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records, and narrow the list by date, subject, species, controlled drugs.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs: pending, administered, skipped, stopped.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the complete life cycle of animal vaccination, from scheduling and direct vaccination, to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate dose recording, and provides complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: View by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are categorized as upcoming, pending, skipped and completed, for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule vaccination plans, or directly record vaccines already given, including the confirmed date and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Vaccination record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Record dose, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Quickly, accurately and traceably issue medical products directly to authorized doctors, ensuring timely supply, and automatically updating inventory throughout from issuing the prescription to shelving, with batch information viewable and expiry dates trackable throughout. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insight into inventory problems, freight, purchasing, requests, usage, expiry situations and fast-turnover products, with visual trends to help take action quickly.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filter
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request number, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (shelves and layers)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of shelves/layers for quick access and updating, and support custom data (packaging, unit of measure, salt components, drivers, manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Inventory report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: View inventory by batch with its value and expiry date; flag low-stock/expired items; monitor items about to expire; manage held-in-custody inventory and handle disputes. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track inventory and expiry dates, record purchases/shipments, maintain a unified ledger, handle substitutes/specification variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can write prescriptions and dispense medicine, or collect medicine directly from the pharmacy, all with records kept.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Freight management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track inbound and outbound freight of medicines, and complete processing within the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Inventory adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record inventory changes (loss, damage, expiry); retain audit history; manage supplier returns; download consumption, return, purchasing and dispensing reports, for use in finance and demand analysis.
m.getting-started.title: Quick Start
m.getting-started.intro: The "Quick Start" guide introduces the purpose of this app, and guides new users through the basic steps of setting up a personal profile, understanding the main features and using the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspace
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and enter the work environment designated for you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home page information feed to view updates, use quick navigation entrances, and use core tools through the bottom panel.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending autopsy / pending medication / pending allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting autopsy, administrative paperwork handling, and subsequent allocation or disposal procedures; only after completion can the record be finally closed.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master data setup and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure master data, and learn about modules such as medical records, housing, eggs, diet and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization settings
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your personal profile and adjust language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels needed for safe operation.
